title: Split bar presentation for a compact-flat-generator augmented tower
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme and $A$ its category of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let $(L_n,l_n)$ be a tower of bounded-above cochain complexes (stage bounds may vary). Assume every $l_n^i$ has a retraction and that each $L_n^i$ is a coproduct of flat module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], each of which is coproduct-compact: every morphism from it to any small coproduct factors through the canonical inclusion of a finite subcoproduct. Let $T$ be an actual flat telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] and let $p_n:L_n\to T$ satisfy $l_np_{n+1}=p_n$. There exist bounded-above termwise-flat towers $(R_n,s_n)$ and $(F_n,u_n)$, quasi-isomorphisms $c_n:R_n\to L_n$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], and maps $a_n:R_n\to F_n$ with $s_nc_{n+1}=c_nl_n$ and $s_na_{n+1}=a_nu_n$. There are a cochain complex $B$, maps $b:\bigoplus F_n\to B$ and $e:B\to T$, and $\delta b=0$, where $\delta=1-\mathrm{shift}$ for $(F_n,u_n)$ [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. In every degree the short complex $\bigoplus F_n\xrightarrow{\delta}\bigoplus F_n\xrightarrow{b}B$ has a splitting (a retraction of the first map and a section of the second map whose two complementary projections sum to the identity). The homotopy quotient maps $e$ to an isomorphism, and $(\bigoplus a_n)b e=\operatorname{desc}(c_np_n)$. This asserts the split presentation and the geometric bar equivalence, not the canonical map out of the telescope cone.

proof.text: Obtain the finite compact-flat subcomplex diagrams and then the canonical enlarged bar union augmentation. Use the resulting maps and identities to choose the cokernel of the telescope differential as B, with its canonical projection b and the induced map e. The degreewise splitting follows from the explicit finite-support recurrence for identity minus shift; the final equality follows by coproduct extensionality and the augmentation identity.

theorem exists_compact_flat_telescope_bar_enlargement (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (L : ℕ → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (l : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⟶ L (n + 1))
    (hb : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((L n).X i))
    (hsplit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), IsSplitMono ((l n).f i))
    (hgen :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), ∃ (I : Type u)
        (G : I → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)),
        Nonempty ((L n).X i ≅ ∐ G) ∧
        (∀ j : I, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (G j)) ∧
        ∀ (j : I) (K : Type u)
          (H : K → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
          (f : G j ⟶ ∐ H),
          ∃ (S : Finset K) (g : G j ⟶ ∐ (fun k : {k // k ∈ S} ↦ H k.1)),
            g ≫ Sigma.desc (fun k : {k // k ∈ S} ↦ Sigma.ι H k.1) = f)
    (T : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hT : isFlatTelescope Y T) (p : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⟶ T)
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, l n ≫ p (n + 1) = p n) :
    let A := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let Q := HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ (R F : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ)
      (s : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ R (n + 1))
      (u : ∀ n : ℕ, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
      (c : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ L n) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ F n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((R n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((R n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((F n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((F n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso (c n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, s n ≫ c (n + 1) = c n ≫ l n) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, s n ≫ a (n + 1) = a n ≫ u n) ∧
      ∃ (B : CochainComplex A ℤ) (b : (∐ F) ⟶ B) (e : B ⟶ T)
        (hzero : flatTelescopeDifferential F u ≫ b = 0),
        (∀ i : ℤ, Nonempty
          (((ShortComplex.mk (flatTelescopeDifferential F u) b hzero).map
            (HomologicalComplex.eval A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i)).Splitting)) ∧
        IsIso (Q.map e) ∧
        Limits.Sigma.map a ≫ b ≫ e = Sigma.desc (fun n : ℕ ↦ c n ≫ p n)
